# Week 3 - Day 2: Linear Regression

## Objective

Train and evaluate a Linear Regression model using Scikit-learn to predict continuous values.

## Topics Covered

- Linear Regression
- Model Training
- Model Prediction
- Coefficients & Intercept
- MAE
- RMSE
- R² Score
- Baseline Comparison

## Tasks Completed

- Loaded the California Housing dataset.
- Split the dataset into training and testing sets.
- Trained a Linear Regression model.
- Generated predictions on the test set.
- Interpreted the model coefficients and intercept.
- Evaluated the model using MAE, RMSE, and R².
- Compared the model against a simple baseline.

## Tools Used

- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Scikit-learn
- Jupyter Notebook
- Git & GitHub
